release_title: MiniMax M2 & Agent: Ingenious in Simplicity

models.name: MiniMax-M2
models.variant: agent-first open-weights model; efficient activated-parameter design; recommended serving params temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=20 (deployment recommendation, not eval protocol)

pricing.note: 页面同时给出人民币定价：输入 ¥2.1、输出 ¥8.4 每百万 tokens；另载限时免费试用至 2025-11-07

models.capability_summary: 发布文以“简中之巧（Ingenious in Simplicity）”为题，将 M2 定位为 agent 优先的开源权重模型，价格约为 Claude Sonnet 的 8%、速度约 2 倍。9 项评测集中于智能体编码、工具调用与搜索，亮点为 GAIA（纯文本）75.7 与 τ²-Bench 77.2。

locator.heading: paragraph after agentic comparison chart ('on the popular Artificial Analysis benchmark')
locator.figure: images/13.png (archive of AA Intelligence Index v3.0 chart)
locator.quote_snippet: on the popular Artificial Analysis benchmark, which integrates 10 test tasks, our model ranked in the top five globally

benchmark_evidence.notes: aa-intelligence-index id already introduced by prior batches, still not in data/benchmarks/. Prose rank claim (top five globally) verified; index v3.0 aggregates MMLU-Pro, GPQA Diamond, HLE, LiveCodeBench, SciCode, AIME 2025, IFBench, AA-LCR, Terminal-Bench Hard, tau^2-Bench Telecom. Vision-assisted read of the reprinted AA chart (unconfirmed, third-party values): MiniMax-M2 61 rank 5; GPT-5 (high) / GPT-5 Codex (high) 68, Grok 4 65, Claude 4.5 Sonnet 63, GLM-4.6 56, Qwen3 Max 55, DeepSeek V3.2 Exp 57, Kimi K2 0905 50. Attribution is third_party_reported (AA runs the eval); excluded from vendor self-report counts. 视觉转写自归档图 images/13.png（2026-09-01）：图中 MiniMax-M2 柱标注 61（该图为整数刻度，无小数）；Kimi K2 0905 同图 50。

notes: Release date printed on page: 2025-10-27 (also free-trial extension to November 7th 00:00 UTC corroborates late-Oct timing). Old URL minimax.io/blog/minimax-m2 now 404s; live slug is minimax-m2-en-1748600000 (the numeric suffix is not the release timestamp - page date is authoritative). Page is Next.js JS-rendered: web reader returned only the site shell, so a headless-browser DOM scan was required (same degradation path as GLM-5.3-Flash and MiniMax M3). Prose contains no absolute benchmark scores; all agentic/coding/search values render inside one 8676x3593 comparison image -> rows pending with vision-assisted reads in notes only (goal.md 12.5). The single verified row is the Artificial Analysis top-five rank claim (third_party_reported, excluded from vendor self-report counts). Unlike the M3 post, this page has no Evaluation Methodology section - harness/sampling protocol undisclosed; recommended serving params (temp 1.0 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20) are deployment guidance, not eval protocol, hence recorded null. Comparison columns in the big image: MiniMax-M2, DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM-4.6, Kimi K2 0905, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5, GPT-5 (thinking). Two price/speed scatter charts and a 1-on-1 practical-performance comparison image were not transcribed (no benchmark row names). Positioning: 8% of Claude Sonnet price, ~2x speed; weights open-sourced on HuggingFace. 2026-09-01 audit: all 8 panels of images/12.png re-read (vision) and matched cell-by-cell; AA chart 13.png re-read (M2 61, rank 5 of 24 bars). No missing benchmark item found - page has exactly these 8 panels plus the AA prose claim.
